title: Dutch Hash with Hearty Onion
description: A hearty and flavorful hash recipe made with homemade potato and crispy onions, inspired by Dutch cuisine.

ingredients.name: Homemade Potato
ingredients.notes: Use leftover mashed potato if available

ingredients.name: Hearty Onion
ingredients.notes: Caramelize the onions before adding to the hash

instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat.
Add 2 tablespoons of oil and sauté diced potatoes until golden brown.
Add sliced onions and cook until caramelized.
Add hash browns (if using) and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
